description: Shows a chat's changes, plan, subagents, scheduled tasks, and sources beside the conversation.

desktop.description: Adds a summary card beside the conversation and a header button to show it.

interface.shortDescription: See what a chat used at a glance
interface.longDescription: Summary keeps a card next to the conversation with what a chat changed, its plan, subagents, and scheduled tasks, and the websites, files, skills, and tools it used. Reopen a website or file with one click.
interface.defaultPrompt: Which sources did this chat use?
